reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, non-trivial combination: a thin, nanocrystalline refractory high-entropy alloy coating applied by magnetron sputtering to TC4. While the individual mechanisms (solid solution, grain boundary strengthening) are general knowledge, no passage studies this exact material/process combination. The passages focus on laser cladding, nitriding, composite electrodeposition, or other coating types, and none propose magnetron-sputtered nanocrystalline RHEA coatings on TC4 to simultaneously achieve hardness, wear resistance, strong bonding, and property preservation. The idea is a new synthesis of known strengthening concepts applied to a novel coating system.
